message: No access to the existing web quotation tool (no URL/credentials/name anywhere in repo: checked roadmap.md, integration-contracts.md section 4, architecture.md, data-model.md). Ticket needs screenshots or technical access to document restrictions (min part size, face orientation), data outputs, export formats -- this is raw discovery a human must perform (ticket's own recommended model is 'human + haiku, summarization only'). Did not create discovery/quotation-tool/notes.md since no real material exists to summarize -- inventing values would violate the never-invent-formats-or-values principle applied here. Unblock: human supplies tool access/URL or screenshots plus restriction notes; agent can then draft notes.md from that material.
